tables: THE TWO LAW TABLES OF ADDENDUM 13 ARE RE-POINTED, NOT REPEATED. Their 1,075 bars and rows were re-classified on 2026-09-12 under the owner's re-cut: 434 were STRUCK OUTRIGHT and 287 more lost half their teeth, because they policed PERMISSION, TONE or CONSTRUCTION rather than truth. The four that most damaged the prose are gone entirely: W15's always-safe spelling list (thirty-one prescriptions that forced twelve renderings onto one approved noun), W24's record-word table, W20's layer bar and W22's person bar. DO NOT APPLY THEM FROM MEMORY. What survived is 179 contradiction rows plus 62 findings the conversion discovered, 44 of which are NEW BARS - and all of it lives in ONE file you read instead: rewrite/recut/CONTRADICTION-TABLE.md, which opens with the test in the refuter's own words and an explicit list of WHAT IS NO LONGER A FINDING. Read your desk's section of it and that header list. THE NEW BARS THAT BIND THE DEFENSE DESK, each measured from the engine and none of them stated by any old rule: a MILITIA and a WATCH are MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE (exclusiveGroup 'civilianDefense'), so a town never has both as standing bodies; a Town watch is PART-TIME by its own catalogue row (the separate city row is Professional city watch), so a town watch is never professional, never full-time, never soldiers; EVERY CITY HAS A GARRISON (required true, professional soldiers, noble or royal), so no city is written without soldiers of its own and 'the garrison' off a town barracks never imports the city rung; there are FOUR upkeep gates on the defense page, not two, all monotone in econOutput, so no face splits their direction (never the watch paid and the muster not); the shortfall is BOUNDED on every gate and the unpaid community baseline is exempt, so the licensed extreme is short, late or thin and NEVER none; the occupation note runs the other way from the old bar, so an occupied town's own bodies are not swept away; the readiness band moves on tier and country while no works move, so a low band is never explained by the works' condition; and the town's printed AGE turns history into a live contradiction source, so age-flavour is free EXCEPT where it denies the printed age. THE FIVE CLOSED ROSTERS (floor 1): the institution roster over the LIVE roster, the force buckets (garrison, militia, watch, mercenary, charter), the faction list, the faith entries, the NPC office roster. A body, building, record-keeper, force or faith-house they do not carry may not be asserted. EVERY OTHER ABSENCE IS SILENCE, AND SILENCE IS PERMISSION.
rulings: WHAT WOULD BE FALSE ON DS-DEF-1 (the defensive posture header: readiness STRONG/ADEQUATE/WEAK/CRITICAL, terrain FAVOURABLE/EXPOSED, strategic value HIGH/LOW; 8 pools, 26 variants). NOTE FOR ANY SEAT WHO READ THE EARLIER RULINGS FOR THIS BLOCK: they rested on the LAYER BAR (W20), which the owner's re-cut STRUCK. A body word is no longer forbidden here because the read is an aggregate. What does the work now is the PREIMAGE, and it is sharper. THE PREIMAGE IS THE WHOLE OF THIS BLOCK'S DIFFICULTY: the readiness pools key on a BAND of the overall score and NOT on the roster, so one face prints across every town whose score lands in that band - walled and unwalled, garrisoned and empty, town and city, quiet country and active siege. A face that names a wall, a gate, a perimeter, a watch, a garrison, a muster or a granary therefore asserts a body the key does not guarantee, and on the towns in the band that lack it the face is FALSE against a CLOSED ROSTER (floor 1). That is a contradiction, not a matter of taste, and it is the single fault this block will produce most. The same reasoning frees what it does not bar: a face may speak freely about what the BAND itself means, about the approach, the ground, the weather over the site, the ordinary day, what a stranger forms an impression of, what the town does not trouble itself about - none of which the roster can deny. THE LADDER IS THE VOCABULARY, and it is exact: STRONG is at or above 65, well covered; ADEQUATE at or above 40, covered but with little margin; WEAK at or above 20, thinly covered and a real threat would strain it; CRITICAL below 20, effectively uncovered. The overall reading runs from well defended down to undefended. A face states the rung its pool keys on and never a fifth gradation between them. THE FENCE THE ANNEX STATES ITSELF: the readiness word is a SUMMARY of five arms and asserts nothing about any one of them, so a STRONG header over a CRITICAL food arm is a real and common state - no face may imply which arm is strong, name a particular pressure, or say what the town has standing against anything. And the band MOVES ON TIER AND COUNTRY while no works move (the mean of the arms plus a tier bonus minus a threat penalty), so no face explains a band by the condition of what the town has built: that is floor 4, a denial of the engine's own model. FLOOR 2 BINDS HARD HERE because a band invites a trend: no comparative against an earlier state (thinner than it was, has been narrowing), no elapsed course, no prediction of what would happen if tested, no count and no rate. The habitual present is your instrument. THE TERRAIN LENS: 'terrain FAVOURABLE' fires on Mountain, Hills AND Forest together, so the only reading true of all three is the one the engine computes - the ground carries part of the defence and the same works are worth more here than on flat ground. Relief is FALSE of Forest and cover is FALSE of Mountain, so neither is licensed; and the APPROACH is a different field (tradeRouteAccess), so narrows, the long way round and in the open are contradictions of that field, not descriptions of this one. 'terrain EXPOSED' fires on Plains and Desert/Arid: open ground that carries nothing of the defence. 'No hill' holds; 'no narrows' does not. COASTAL AND RIVERSIDE FIRE NEITHER TERRAIN POOL ON PURPOSE (a water flank is neither narrows nor nothing), so no face of either pool mentions water. Terrain and strategic value are STANDING facts of the site with no recorded history: no face says the town was sited, chosen or founded anywhere for any reason. THE PRIZE LENS: 'strategic value HIGH' fires on Coastal and Mountain, so the shared reading is the engine's own - the town holds something worth taking; a face names neither sea nor mountain nor what the thing is. 'strategic value LOW' fires on Forest only: not a prize. Medium and Medium-High fire neither pool. strategicValue is an engine-authored string the page already prints beside the prose, so the prose FRAMES it and never restates or paraphrases it - restating it is a same-page collision under floor 1. THE SLOTS: only {settlement} is filled at this block's call sites; {band}, {route} and {counterpart} are declared and NOT filled at this tip, and a variant naming any of them drops. THE SHIPPED CLAUSES THAT ARE STILL FALSE: 'the approaches are watched, the works are kept up' (bodies the key does not guarantee); 'enough on the walls to be serious' (a body and a manning); 'how much of the perimeter has nobody on it' (the same, and the annex's own fence denies it); 'a stranger reaches the centre without being stopped, challenged or counted by anybody at all' (bodies, and a totality); 'the margin has been narrowing' (floor 2); 'takes the time it takes to walk in' and 'not worth the price of trying' (predictions); 'tested twice at once' (a prediction); 'the approach is narrow ... the long way and in the open' (the approach field); 'has paid for and must keep paying for' (no gate read is on this block). EVERYTHING ELSE THE SHIPPED ROWS SAY IS AVAILABLE TO YOU AGAIN, including the standpoints and the second facts the old law struck: 'the town does not spend much time thinking about being attacked, and the reason is not complacency' is lawful and is the kind of line this block should be reaching for.
